properties.description: Validates selector combinations, escapes OData string literals by doubling apostrophes, and builds exact organization and catalog routes.
properties.display_name: Validate blueprint selector and build lookup routes
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

organization = sys.argv[1].strip()
selectorType = sys.argv[2].strip()
catalogName = sys.argv[3].strip()
catalogMoid = sys.argv[4].strip()
blueprintName = sys.argv[5].strip()
versionSelection = sys.argv[6].strip()
try:
    blueprintVersion = int(sys.argv[7])
except Exception:
    blueprintVersion = 0
errors = []
if not organization:
    errors.append("Workload Organization must not be blank.")
if selectorType not in ("Name", "Moid"):
    errors.append("Catalog Selector Type must be Name or Moid.")
if selectorType == "Name" and not catalogName:
    errors.append("Catalog Name is required for the Name selector.")
if selectorType == "Moid" and not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9A-Fa-f]{24}", catalogMoid):
    errors.append("Catalog Moid must be a 24-character hexadecimal Moid.")
if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,31}", blueprintName):
    errors.append("Blueprint Name does not meet the public-schema pattern.")
if versionSelection not in ("Default", "Specific"):
    errors.append("Version Selection must be Default or Specific.")
if versionSelection == "Specific" and blueprintVersion < 1:
    errors.append("Blueprint Version must be at least 1 for Specific selection.")
status = "invalid" if errors else "ok"
statusCode = 400 if errors else 200
message = " ".join(errors) if errors else "Blueprint selector is valid."
resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":")) if errors else "{}"
ready = True
escapedOrganization = organization.replace("'", "''")
organizationUrl = "/api/v1/organization/Organizations?$filter=Name eq '%s'&$select=Moid,Name" % escapedOrganization
if selectorType == "Moid":
    catalogUrl = "/api/v1/workflow/Catalogs/%s?$select=Moid,Name,Organization" % catalogMoid
else:
    catalogUrl = "/api/v1/workflow/Catalogs?$filter=Name eq '%s'&$select=Moid,Name,Organization&$top=2" % catalogName.replace("'", "''")
requestedCatalogName = catalogName
requestedCatalogMoid = catalogMoid

properties.script:
import json
import sys

status = "ok"
statusCode = 200
message = "Organization resolved"
resultJson = "{}"
ready = False
organizationMoid = ""
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    rows = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(rows, list):
        raise ValueError("Organization response does not contain a Results array.")
    expectedName = sys.argv[2].strip()
    if len(rows) != 1:
        status = "not-found" if len(rows) == 0 else "conflict"
        statusCode = 404 if len(rows) == 0 else 409
        message = "Organization lookup must return exactly one result; received %d." % len(rows)
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message, "resultCount": len(rows)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif rows[0].get("Name") != expectedName:
        status = "identity-mismatch"
        statusCode = 409
        message = "Organization response does not preserve the exact requested Name."
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        organizationMoid = str(rows[0].get("Moid") or "")
        if not organizationMoid:
            raise ValueError("The exact organization result has no Moid.")
        resultJson = json.dumps({"organization": rows[0]}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status = "malformed"
    statusCode = 502
    message = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True

properties.script:
import json
import sys

body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
selectorType = sys.argv[2]
organizationMoid = sys.argv[3]
blueprintName = sys.argv[4]
versionSelection = sys.argv[5]
blueprintVersion = int(sys.argv[6])
requestedCatalogName = sys.argv[7]
requestedCatalogMoid = sys.argv[8]
rows = body.get("Results") if selectorType == "Name" and isinstance(body, dict) else [body]
status = "ok"
statusCode = 200
message = "Catalog resolved"
resultJson = "{}"
ready = False
catalogMoid = ""
blueprintUrl = ""
try:
    if not isinstance(rows, list):
        raise ValueError("Catalog lookup response has the wrong shape.")
    if len(rows) != 1:
        status = "not-found" if len(rows) == 0 else "conflict"
        statusCode = 404 if len(rows) == 0 else 409
        message = "Catalog selection must resolve exactly one accessible catalog; received %d. Use Catalog Moid when names collide." % len(rows)
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message, "resultCount": len(rows)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        selected = rows[0]
        catalogMoid = str(selected.get("Moid") or "")
        relationship = selected.get("Organization")
        relatedMoid = relationship.get("Moid") if isinstance(relationship, dict) else ""
        if not catalogMoid:
            raise ValueError("Selected catalog has no Moid.")
        if (selectorType == "Name" and selected.get("Name") != requestedCatalogName) or (selectorType == "Moid" and catalogMoid.lower() != requestedCatalogMoid.lower()):
            status = "identity-mismatch"
            statusCode = 409
            message = "The returned catalog does not preserve the exact requested selector identity."
            resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
        elif relatedMoid and relatedMoid != organizationMoid:
            status = "forbidden"
            statusCode = 403
            message = "The selected local catalog belongs to a different organization. Shared catalogs with no Organization relationship remain eligible."
            resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message, "catalogMoid": catalogMoid}, separators=(",", ":"))
        else:
            escapedBlueprint = blueprintName.replace("'", "''")
            filterText = "Catalog.Moid eq '%s' and Name eq '%s'" % (catalogMoid, escapedBlueprint)
            filterText += " and DefaultVersion eq true" if versionSelection == "Default" else " and Version eq %d" % blueprintVersion
            blueprintUrl = "/api/v1/workload/Blueprints?$filter=" + filterText + "&$select=Moid,Name,Version,DefaultVersion,Catalog&$top=2"
            resultJson = json.dumps({"catalog": selected}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status = "malformed"
    statusCode = 502
    message = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True

properties.script:
import json
import sys

body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
catalogMoid, blueprintName, versionSelection = sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4]
blueprintVersion = int(sys.argv[5])
rows = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
status, statusCode, message, resultJson, ready = "ok", 200, "Blueprint resolved", "{}", False
blueprintMoid = ""
blueprintItemUrl = ""
try:
    if not isinstance(rows, list):
        raise ValueError("Blueprint response does not contain a Results array.")
    if len(rows) != 1:
        status = "not-found" if len(rows) == 0 else "conflict"
        statusCode = 404 if len(rows) == 0 else 409
        message = "Blueprint selection must resolve exactly one version; received %d." % len(rows)
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message, "resultCount": len(rows)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        row = rows[0]
        relatedCatalog = row.get("Catalog") if isinstance(row.get("Catalog"), dict) else {}
        valid = row.get("Name") == blueprintName and relatedCatalog.get("Moid") == catalogMoid
        valid = valid and ((versionSelection == "Default" and row.get("DefaultVersion") is True) or (versionSelection == "Specific" and int(row.get("Version", 0)) == blueprintVersion))
        blueprintMoid = str(row.get("Moid") or "")
        if not valid or not blueprintMoid:
            status, statusCode = "identity-mismatch", 409
            message = "The returned blueprint does not preserve the requested catalog/name/version identity."
            resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message, "returned": row}, separators=(",", ":"))
        else:
            blueprintItemUrl = "/api/v1/workload/Blueprints/" + blueprintMoid
            resultJson = json.dumps({"selected": row}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status, statusCode, message = "malformed", 502, str(exc)
    resultJson, ready = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":")), True

properties.script:
import json
import sys

status, statusCode, message, resultJson, ready = "ok", 200, "Blueprint details retrieved", "{}", False
finalResultJson = "{}"
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    catalog = body.get("Catalog") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    selectorValid = isinstance(body, dict) and ((sys.argv[5] == "Default" and body.get("DefaultVersion") is True) or (sys.argv[5] == "Specific" and int(body.get("Version", 0)) == int(sys.argv[6])))
    if not isinstance(body, dict) or body.get("Moid") != sys.argv[2] or body.get("Name") != sys.argv[4] or not isinstance(catalog, dict) or catalog.get("Moid") != sys.argv[3] or not selectorValid:
        status, statusCode = "identity-mismatch", 409
        message = "Full blueprint item identity does not match the selected blueprint."
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        finalResultJson = json.dumps(body, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
        resultJson = finalResultJson
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status, statusCode, message = "malformed", 502, str(exc)
    resultJson, ready = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":")), True

Returns one exact Cisco Unified Edge workload blueprint version with its input definition, dependencies, generated-object and service-item metadata, resource constraints, platform type, and validation state. The selected Intersight target must allow organization, workflow catalog, and workload blueprint reads. Name-based catalog selection accepts only one accessible exact-name match; use Catalog Moid when shared and local catalogs collide. The workflow does not list blueprints and performs no mutation. Shared-catalog organization behavior requires live-tenant validation.
